spans.s: .] A lip (lower or upper); द्वावोष्ठौ छेदयेन्नृपः

; अधर˚, बिम्ब˚. -ष्ठी A creeper bearing a red fruit to which the lip is commonly compared (बिम्बफल; Mar. तोण्डली). (In comp. the अ or आ of words before ओष्ठ may be optionally dropped, and the fem. may end in आ or ई as बिम्बो (म्बौ) ष्ठा-ष्ठी. [Vārt. ओत्वोष्ठयोः समासे वा Sk. on
.] [cf. L. ostium]. -Comp. -अधरौ, -रम् the upper and lower lip. -अवलोप्य a. Which could be eaten with lips; मांसान्योष्ठावलोप्यानि साधनीयानि, देवताः । अश्नन्ति... ॥

. -उपमफला, -भा -फला the creeper Bryonia Grandis (whose fruit resembles a lip. Mar. तोंडली). -कोपः, -प्रकोपः a disease of the lips. -ज a. labial (produced by the lips). -जाहम् the root of the lip. -पल्लवः, -वम् a sprout-like or tender lip. -पाकः The cracking of lips due to cold &c. -पुटम् the cavity made by opening the lips. -पुष्पः -पुष्पम् the tree वन्धुक (Mar. दुपारी).-रोगः any disease of the lips.
ओष्ठक [ōṣṭhaka], a. (At the end of comp.) Taking care of the lips. -कः A lip.
Belonging to the lips, labial (as the sounds). -Comp. -योनि a. Produced from labial sounds. -स्थान a. Pronounced with lips.
